title: Presentation envelope
description: Every resolved component payload has this one shape (Contract - Presentation Primitive, "The envelope"). `description` is the card revision's description, a `card_revision` description under `https://developmentfinance.org/descriptions/schema/v1/description.schema.json` (package `dfo-spec-kit-descriptions`); a card that carries one holds only lineage in `provenance`, and a data card issued without one keeps its sources, freshness, warnings and citation there, and a narration note, which draws no data, carries lineage alone. `component` is closed to the members this catalogue release ships (line_chart, bar_chart, table, stat_card, note_narration, source_card); a member added later is a new catalogue release, per "The union is closed per release".

schema_version.description: the integer version of the catalogue schema this payload was generated against

component_id.description: globally unique, minted at creation; the id every edit tool targets

revision.description: increments on every applied edit; revisions are immutable once minted

description.$comment: A card with a description keeps lineage alone in provenance: sources, freshness, caveats and its citation live in the description.

else.$comment: Every member but note_narration resolves a frame, so provenance.inputs names at least the one frame it resolved; note_narration carries no frame_ref and its own inputs stays empty, the base bound (minItems 0) the $defs/provenance schema declares. A data card issued without a description keeps its sources, freshness, warnings and citation in provenance; note_narration draws no data and carries lineage alone. Such a card names each source by its `provenance.sources[].id`, so every `source_ref` and `source_refs[]` entry holds to `$defs/source_id`; a described card names `description.sources[].ref`, and that the named entry exists is checked in code.

catalog_version.$comment: Calver, provisional; redefined in place pre-freeze rather than bumped, until a first real freeze fixes it.

spec_id.$comment: spec_ (Datasets) or ops_ (Analysis Toolkit) prefix per "Frame and series references"; hex-length bound is loose because the contract itself calls identifier spellings illustrative pending the identifier decision.

content_version.$comment: cv_ (Datasets) or ocv_ (Analysis Toolkit) prefix per "Frame and series references", matching the prefixes `spec_id` accepts; hex-length bound is loose for the same reason.

description.$comment: The description schema ships in dfo-spec-kit-descriptions and is resolved by its $id. A card describes its own revision.

source_id.description: the id of an entry in `provenance.sources`

provenance.description: Lineage: the frames a component resolved, the replay key, when it was generated and the revision it was refreshed from. `sources`, `freshness`, `warnings` and `citation` appear only on a component issued without a `description`.

inputs.description: empty for a component with no frame_ref (note_narration); every other member names at least the one frame it resolved.

execution_ref.description: the key the recipe of the derived frame the component resolved replays it under; null when the component resolves a dataset frame, a frame with no recipe or no frame, and on every revision issued before components wrote a replay key

ref.description: the Data Commons provenance dcid this entry was built from (for example `provenance/OECDCreditorReportingSystem` or `dc/base/WorldDevelopmentIndicators`), so a renderer can look the source up in the graph; absent on components minted before platforms wrote it

source.description: the Data Commons Source node behind the provenance (for a UN System Data Commons series, the agency provenance itself); absent on dataset versions minted before the origin catalogue

data_commons.description: the Data Commons the provenance is served from; absent on dataset versions minted before the origin catalogue

data_through.$comment: nullable: the upstream frame may not yet supply a coverage-through period.

next_expected.$comment: nullable: not every source publishes a refresh cadence.

kind.$comment: Closed vocabulary drawn from the contract's own examples ("provisional status, estimates, imputations, coverage gaps, comparability breaks"); the taxonomy is seam-owed to the Datasets/Analysis layers that populate it.

generated_at.description: the payload's generation timestamp, stamped by the assembler

citation.description: ready-to-paste string the assembler generates from the structured provenance fields

refreshed_from.description: the revision (of this same component_id) this payload was drawn from on newer data: the revision a render redrew without minting a new one, or the revision a refresh revision was minted from; null otherwise
